WI.name: Wisconsin
WI.basis: Regent Policy Document 4-23 (30 to 36), from fall 2026
WI.scope: Universities of Wisconsin (13 universities) under the Board of Regents; Wis. Stat. 36.31(2m) transfer agreements also bind the Wisconsin Technical College System (tribal and private colleges may opt in)
WI.framework: No Board of Regents systemwide general education credit minimum found; each university sets its own. Statutory transfer framework: Wis. Stat. 36.31(2m)(b) requires the Regents and the WTCS board to identify an array of not less than 72 credits of core general education courses that transfer and satisfy general education requirements at the receiving institution (from 2022-23); the earlier Universal Credit Transfer Agreement is a transfer block.
WI.credit_rule: Former minimum removed: RPD 4-12 had stated “The required minimum number of credits for a degree program is 120 credits” (since 2012). Resolution 12449 (adopted 3/05/2026) amended RPD 4-12 so that UW institutions “should conform to commonly accepted minimum program lengths, as indicated by Higher Learning Commission policy,” including 120 credit hours for bachelor’s degrees, and any variation must be explained and justified. RPD 4-12 also requires periodic review of programs requiring more than 130 credits (Res. 11677, 2021).
WI.credit_citation: Regent Policy Document 4-12, Academic Program Planning, Review, and Approval in the University of Wisconsin System (as amended by Res. 12449, 3/05/2026)
